title: Mystic Library Ritual
description: An elderly witch in a purple robe stands at a marble desk in a gothic library, performing a ritual with green magical energy flowing from her hands. A large framed painting on the desk depicts a stormy sea with a ship and a mermaid, surrounded by scattered papers, an open spellbook, a dripping red candle, and glowing lanterns.
prompt: An elderly female witch with gray hair in an elegant updo and a dark purple star-patterned robe stands at a marble desk inside a towering gothic library filled with ancient books. She is casting a spell with glowing green energy between her hands. On the desk sits a large ornate painting of a stormy ocean with a sailing ship and a mermaid, surrounded by an open spellbook, scattered magical papers, a lit lantern, and a red candle with dripping wax. Stormy lightning visible through a large arched window, hanging magical lanterns with blue and purple glows, moody atmospheric lighting.
